# Synthetic ldapsearch-style export for the directory-investigation
# scenario. Re-asserts Alice and HOST01 from a second evidence source
# so the alias index can carry multiple evidence_sources for the same
# canonical key without an implicit merge of conflicting facts.

dn: CN=Alice,OU=People,DC=corp,DC=local
objectClass: top
objectClass: person
objectClass: organizationalPerson
objectClass: user
cn: Alice
sAMAccountName: alice
userPrincipalName: alice@corp.local
objectGUID: 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111
objectSid: S-1-5-21-1111111111-2222222222-3333333333-1001
memberOf: CN=Admins,OU=Groups,DC=corp,DC=local

dn: CN=HOST01,CN=Computers,DC=corp,DC=local
objectClass: top
objectClass: computer
cn: HOST01
sAMAccountName: HOST01$
objectGUID: 33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333
